from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u019/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d8e2d3cf.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != background and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            components.append(comp)
    template = max(components, key=len)
    template_set = set(template)
    r0 = min(r for r,c in template); r1 = max(r for r,c in template)
    c0 = min(c for r,c in template); c1 = max(c for r,c in template)
    anchor_r = (r0 + r1) // 2
    anchor_c = (c0 + c1) // 2
    patch = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    markers = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != background and (r,c) not in template_set]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for mr, mc in markers:
        top = mr - (anchor_r-r0)
        left = mc - (anchor_c-c0)
        for dy, row in enumerate(patch):
            for dx, value in enumerate(row):
                y, x = top+dy, left+dx
                if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                    out[y][x] = value
    return out
'''
